sloka: स तु मोहात् सुसङ्क्रुद्धः कृतान्तबलचोदितः ।क्रोधसंरक्तनयनो रावणः सूतमब्रवीत् ।। ६.१०६.१ ।।
transliteration: sa tu mohāt susaṅkruddhaḥ kṛtāntabalacoditaḥ ।krodhasaṁraktanayano rāvaṇaḥ sūtamabravīt ।। 6.106.1 ।।

translations.english: Enraged out of delusion, by force of destiny, Ravana's eyes turned red in anger and spoke to his charioteer.
